company.name: Pomelo Care
company.shortDescription: Pomelo Care is a health technology company that develops evidence-based healthcare solutions for women and children.
company.description: Pomelo Care is a health technology company that develops evidence-based healthcare solutions for women and children. The company provides a digital care coordination and patient engagement platform designed to support longitudinal care outside traditional clinical settings. Its software connects patients, families, and care teams by centralizing clinical data, care plans, messaging, and care milestones into a single interface that enhances communication and continuity of care. The platform supports workflows across chronic condition management, post-discharge follow-ups, and complex care plans by enabling asynchronous updates, task tracking, assessment collection, and outcome monitoring. Pomelo Care’s tools are used by healthcare providers, care coordinators, and patient support organizations to streamline care delivery, improve engagement, and personalize interventions based on individual patient needs. It also offers integrations with electronic health records and third-party health services to synchronize information flows and reduce administrative burdens.
